BiblicalUsage: Etam is a place in Palestine. In Judges 15:8, the text says "and he went down and dwelt in the top of the rock Etam." It is a place, not a person, so there is no People profile for it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Etam matters because God's story happened in real places, and Etam is one of them.
